title: Theatre & Game Room, Heated Pool, Spa & 2 Kitchens
description: Escape to your private oasis in Phoenix, just 15 minutes from Kierland Commons and top golf courses. Perfect for family gatherings, golf trips, or celebrations, this luxurious home features six bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and two kitchens. The stunning backyard offers a heated pool, spa, putting green, fire pit, and fun outdoor games. Whether you’re planning a family gathering, golf trip, bachelor/ette celebrations or a relaxing getaway, this home has everything you need for an exceptional stay!
